agreements: The only admissible scientific question remains a six-life, postcommit, query-guided public-evidence-allocation observation; it is not discovery, final behavior, parametric learning, transport, memory advantage, efficiency, or an automatic follow-up authority.

THINK_0 may affect only the trusted selector, every DREAM output remains append-only and provisional through MEMORY_1, and a frozen scorer must have no cognition-time, mutation, scheduling, retry, repair, promotion, or provider edge.

OUT_OF_STRATUM lives must be executed and reported when their inputs are legitimate but ineligible; they may not contribute distractor-go credit, and any eventual outcome must terminate at human review.

disagreements.issue: Hash-named inheritance and aggregate testing do not prove executable inherited-gate coverage, transitive byte closure, or identical reviewer and analyst evidence.

positions.position: The v2 hashes and aggregate inherited-contract test sufficiently preserve the inherited contract.
Inheritance remains non-executable until exact gate-to-evidence mapping, override precedence, transitive closure, and common reviewer inputs are bound.

resolution.rationale: The latter position is required: byte hashes identify sources but cannot demonstrate their execution or make their full evidence inspectable.
resolution.selected_position: Machine-executable inheritance closure before any v2b review or ratification.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 01: add a normative v2b architecture specification and a machine-readable inheritance_map.json with exactly fourteen inherited-v2 test IDs, their v2b evidence artifacts, and one of {unchanged, overridden} for each. Add corrections_override_map.json with exactly the four v2a corrections, their precedence rule, and affected inherited tests. Implement a transitive-freeze manifest that recursively hashes every import, resource, prompt, schema, tokenizer, workflow, test, and runtime entrypoint. Make the preflight reject any unmapped inherited gate, undeclared transitive dependency, missing review input, or reviewer/analyst input-set difference. Bind identical closures for both reviewers and analysis, including inherited v2 spec/change/workflow, adapter, scheduler, provider and ledger tests, capture-environment, runtime-preflight, manifest, selector traces, proposals, and baseline artifacts.

disagreements.issue: The proposed EXACT/NEAR/OUT rule lacks canonical metric definitions and conflicts on missing or non-finite inputs.

positions.position: Missing/non-finite comparisons are OUT_OF_STRATUM while the loop can fail preflight on missing/non-finite inputs.
Legitimate absent matched items must be distinct from malformed, unavailable, or non-finite computation; every metric and class predicate must be byte-reproducible.

resolution.rationale: A stratum label changes the primary contrast, so the rule cannot leave formulas, ordering, or integrity disposition to implementation judgment.
resolution.selected_position: Canonical metric module with a runnable-absence versus integrity-failure split.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 02: freeze one canonical precommit metric module and manifest schema defining candidate universe, witness-kind enum, UTF-8/token serialization, token-multiset overlap numerator and named denominator, endpoint-frequency pairing, one-based rendered position, bounded-memory rank order and tie key, numeric representation, and mechanical closure-opportunity predicate. Define a legitimate absent required matched item as immutable OUT_OF_STRATUM and still runnable; define malformed input, unavailable required public bytes, or non-finite calculation as an integrity failure before provider call. Predeclare zero-eligible behavior and separately report EXACT, NEAR, OUT_OF_STRATUM, and any eligible pooled row; forbid replacement, reclassification, pooling changes, or target adaptation after the frozen manifest.

disagreements.issue: C aliases have no complete redaction grammar, repeat rule, order-independence guarantee, or audit for recoverable selected-view structure.

positions.position: Deterministic call-local aliases externally bound to connector hashes are sufficient.
Determinism alone can encode source order or semantic rank and can leave canonical connector text or join shortcuts visible.

resolution.rationale: The provider boundary is only credible when both byte removal and residual provider-visible recoverability are specified and tested.
resolution.selected_position: Call-seeded, order-independent aliases plus exhaustive renderer grammar and recoverability controls.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 03: specify a call-seeded one-to-one C-alias permutation independent of semantic rank, source order, target, arm, and own/distractor identity; repeated occurrences of one visible connector must reuse one C alias, and the external ledger must bind it only to that connector hash. Freeze a renderer grammar that replaces every connector-bearing provider-visible field, including embedded concept text, and rejects canonical identifiers and private sentinels. Add pre-model per-call recoverability audits for alias label, record order, rendered position, and shared-C joins, with the audit result recorded outside cognition.

disagreements.issue: A 192-character cap does not define a finite legal language or guarantee token fit for actual serialized provider bytes.

positions.position: A frozen tokenizer and 192-character cap permit a maximal legal-operation fit test.
Without normalization, legal character grammar, escaping, serializer, and operation bounds, no finite exhaustive maximum exists.

resolution.rationale: Character count and tokenizer count diverge under escaping and Unicode; the claimed preflight needs one canonical byte domain.
resolution.selected_position: Finite normalized text grammar and canonical serialization before token proof.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 04: define 192 characters by one finite normalized character grammar for every free-text field, explicitly forbid controls, define quote/backslash handling, and freeze canonical JSON serialization, whitespace, UTF-8 encoding, tokenizer revision, and operation-specific maximum records. Preflight must enumerate every operation-specific worst-case serialized byte sequence and prove <=256 generated tokens. Reject 193 characters, 257 tokens, noncanonical serialization, truncation, and repair without altering the operation.

disagreements.issue: Offline normalization is isolated in intent but has no exact mapping semantics or metric rows that distinguish scorer assistance from verbatim model output.

positions.position: A hash-locked scorer-only allowlist with unmatched reporting is sufficient.
Ambiguous mapping, load boundary, and primary score rows must be explicit; normalized-only closure cannot be attributed as raw model closure.

resolution.rationale: Isolation prevents teaching but does not remove the scorer's contribution to normalized equality.
resolution.selected_position: One-to-zero-or-one scorer mapping and three separately reported score rows.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 05: freeze a versioned one-to-zero-or-one relation mapping with explicit ambiguous and unmatched dispositions. Load it only after all eighteen MEMORY_1 commits and independent artifact-graph verification. Preserve raw proposal bytes; write score copies only; predeclare and report verbatim byte-exact closure, allowlist-normalized closure, and witness-bound normalized closure, including every unmatched string and normalization-only gain. Require import-graph and serialized-artifact scans proving allowlist/scorer mutation cannot affect memory, selection, routing, retry, repair, promotion, or a future call.

disagreements.issue: Provider-visible selected evidence and shared C aliases can create closure mechanically, so hidden-selector invariance alone cannot identify a model-associated contribution.

positions.position: Removing hidden selector metadata from provider bytes establishes the cognition boundary.
The boundary is necessary but needs compiler ceilings before any residual is attributed to the model.

resolution.rationale: A query-guided public view is an intentional mediator and may itself encode a deterministic closure shortcut.
resolution.selected_position: Per-arm/life compiler ceilings and a residual-only model-associated description.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 06: before model closure for each arm and life, run and report selected-view byte-only, shared-C join, canonical-string, query-copy, masked-content, wrong-connector, deterministic-retrieval, and deterministic-compiler controls. Freeze their order and inputs in the artifact graph. State only the residual after these ceilings as model-associated, retain hidden-selector-byte invariance as a boundary test, and prohibit discovery or recurrence-generalization language.

disagreements.issue: Schedule inventory, heterogeneous-baseline labeling, result inputs, and terminal routing are insufficiently bound for complete attribution and claim control.

positions.position: Aggregate schedule totals and an unconditional human-stop test close the operational scope.
Every artifact row and terminal state must reconcile, and full-context/RAG cannot be described as matched architectural or efficiency baselines.

resolution.rationale: Call totals without referential closure can conceal omissions or double counting; unlike-arm baselines cannot support a causal superiority statement.
resolution.selected_position: Referentially closed inventory, explicit heterogeneous-baseline labels, and no automatic route beyond human review.
resolution.required_change: V2b correction 07: require an inventory that reconciles exactly 802 recurrent DREAM calls, 102 baseline DREAM calls under the 256/192 contract, 288 selector traces, eighteen MEMORY_1/scorer packets, and a terminal-justified observed THINK prefix <=72 without padding. Link every alias, parser, proposal, score, baseline, and terminal row; reject omissions, duplicates, reorders, and orphans. Label full-context and RAG as heterogeneous contextual competitors; publish calls, tokens, reads, wall time, and opportunity; reserve causal attribution for the three matched RETURN_SLEEP arms; prohibit recurrence, memory, efficiency, or architecture-superiority claims. Route success, null, OUT, control win, timeout, and integrity error only to Rohin with no repair, rerun, replication, LoRA, heldout, claim, external, or spend edge.
